answer: Violet-Reef Draw. Each epoch, a verifiable random function over the epoch's committed beacon assigns every registered agent to a small duty cohort; only cohort members may transact, and cohort membership rotates on a short horizon the attacker cannot see ahead. To hold a live identity an attacker must run a real agent that survives unpredictable cohort selection, paying full operational cost per identity while most sit idle. Mass fake registration yields no usable capacity without matching compute and availability spend.
